scope: Theorem A.1 (Uniform smoothing) of the manuscript “Exponential PSD rank of positively shifted matching matrices” (preprints/Exponential-PSD-rank-of-positively-shifted-matching-matrices-October-5-2026/shifted-matching-psd.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 126 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7e90c5f1e508114d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed ℓ ≥ 1 and K > 0, there are an integer d ≥ 1 and N0 such that, for every even N ≥ N0, every positive integer cell-size vector summing to N, and every admissible table, ∥Tt(I − Πd)∥op ≤ N−K . (A.2) Moreover, for each fixed partition Z and function f, the values (TtΠdf)(Z), as t varies over all admissible tables, are given by a single polynomial of total degree at most d in the intercell counts (tuv)u<v.
